Documentation build dependency: caniuse-lite

The documentation build uses caniuse-lite, a compressed version of the
Can I Use browser support data, to select browser compatibility transforms.

Credit: Can I Use and caniuse-lite contributors.
Original data: https://github.com/Fyrd/caniuse
Compressed data and package: https://github.com/browserslist/caniuse-lite
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY-4.0)
License text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode

Dekaf uses the published caniuse-lite package without modifying its data.
This notice attributes that dependency; it does not change Dekaf's MIT license.
